messages:
maria.l: deployed adaptive-batch-sampler v2 to canary 10:30am. seeing weird tail latency on streaming short-chat flows (<=64 tokens). P99 jumped from 210ms -> 520ms. immediate rollback in canary for now.
aj: thanks for the flag. any traces or flame graphs?
maria.l: grabbing traces now. initial looks: lots of partial-decode flushes interleaved with kernel handoffs. KV cache miss rate spiked ~3x during warmup. snippet from timeline:
```
[stream] admit req id=0x7b3 fa|queued 6ms -> started
[batch] formed size=4 token_budget=48 -> partial-decode flush @ +14ms
[kernel] switch to small-kernel due to slot mismatch
[kv] miss(id=0x7b3) cold -> fetch
```

simon: that token_budget=48 looks suspicious for short-chat; sampler v2 reduces token_budget for head requests but increases batch window to 12ms. might be causing earlier sends + more partials.
nina: can you paste the sampler config you pushed?
maria.l: pushed config:
```
{
  "min_batch_size": 1,
  "max_batch_size": 16,
  "token_budget_per_batch": 48,
  "max_batch_wait_ms": 12,
  "priority_policy": "age_weighted",
  "partial_decode_threshold": 8
}
```
aj: compare to v1 defaults we had in prod: token_budget=64, max_wait=8ms, partial_threshold=6. v2 increases wait and lowers token budget -> likely more early flushes when many short chats arrive.
simon: also check kernel selection hysteresis. if partial decodes cause small kernel to be chosen, larger kernels get evicted from GPU cache -> more kernel load and longer switch times.
perf-bot: perf/regression detected: canary -> prod delta: P95_streaming_short +180ms, KV_miss_rate +2.9x, kernel_switch_rate +1.8x
maria.l: I can try a quick A/B with token_budget=64 + max_wait=10ms on canary to see if it stabilizes. anyone object?
aj: go for it. capture per-slot kernel cache stats and kernel_switch timings.
simon: also add a debug counter for "partial_decode_sends" per request id. if partial_decode_sends > 2 then force full decode send at next flush to avoid oscillation.
nina: FYI we've seen this pattern when we shortened KV warmup timeout recently. the combined effect is cold KV misses + more partials -> longer tail.
maria.l: action list: (1) rollback canary already done, (2) run quick A/B with token_budget=64,max_wait=10, partial_threshold=6 in new canary, (3) add debug counter + kernel_switch timings, (4) collect 1 hour of traces, (5) evaluate KV warmup threshold revert if needed. I'll own 1-4.
aj: ping me when canary is up, happy to run perf harness.
simon: small follow-up: add metric for "avg tokens at flush" so we can see whether batches are being starved by token budget.
maria.l: will do. expected next update ~35m.
perf-bot: deployment: canary config update initiated by maria.l @3159004410
maria.l: canary running with adjusted config now. starting 30m trace window.
aj: initial 5m numbers look promising: P95 down to +40ms delta vs baseline. KV miss rate trending down.
nina: great. suggests token_budget was primary lever here. keep an eye on kernel_switch_rate.
maria.l: 30m window complete. P99 delta now +30ms (within noise), kernel_switch_rate back to baseline, KV miss rate normalized. closing this thread unless we see reoccurrence.
aj: nice work :thumbsup:
simon: add a quick doc note in eng-runtime/ops about the interaction between token_budget and KV warmup so future changes account for it.
maria.l: will draft short blurb.
